authorization: Publisher explicitly authorised three verified daily company-analysis articles on 2 November 2026, superseding the repository's one-new-article daily cap.
story_thesis: Monster's case volume is growing faster than revenue, while lower sales per equivalent case, international mix, freight, input and marketing costs are compressing margins.

identity.form: 8-K with results release; Q2 Form 10-Q for independent business and accounting context
identity.units: USD thousands or millions as stated; case volume in 192-ounce equivalents

duplicate_checks: Checked both editorial inventories, the JSON content inventory and actual wealth content; Monster has a maintained stock profile but no dedicated case-volume-versus-unit-economics analysis.
Checked recent publication records, open and merged pull requests, and live site content; no matching Monster story or fingerprint was active or published.
Checked the 6 November Europe/Dublin scheduled ledger before drafting; all three daily slots were open and no active publication attempt existed.
Routine results remain on /stocks/mnst/; this article addresses unit monetisation, international mix and margin conversion.
candidate_review_reference: See caa343971a2ce75a4e5c2d2a.json for the ten-company screen; Monster was selected independently.

evidence_table.claim: Q3 sales were USD2.563053bn, up 16.7%, while energy-drink case volume rose from 258.387m to 304.902m 192-ounce equivalents, about 18.0%.
Average net sales per case fell to USD8.30 from USD8.35, about 0.6%, excluding Alcohol Brands and Other.
Foreign sales were USD1.199984bn, up 28.1%, and about 47% of total; FX contributed USD8.116m and FX-neutral growth was 16.3%.
evidence_table.result: verified; reported and currency-adjusted growth kept distinct

evidence_table.claim: Gross profit was USD1.400735bn, gross margin 54.7% versus 55.7%, operating income USD718.7m, and calculated operating margin about 28.0% versus 30.7%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Results release statements; 718.7 / 2,563.053 = 28.04%; prior 675.5 / 2,195.538 = 30.77% using reported rounded figures.

evidence_table.claim: Distribution expense rose to USD116.3m, selling expense to USD260.1m, and total operating expense to USD682.018m, which included USD19.9m impairment and USD14.7m digital-transformation costs.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Results release expense tables and management discussion.

evidence_table.claim: Cash plus short-term investments totalled USD3.704252bn; Q3 repurchases were about USD100m, while diluted weighted-average shares rose year over year.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: 2,148.401 + 1,555.851 = 3,704.252; release repurchase and share tables; Q2 10-Q used for programme context.
evidence_table.result: verified; balance-sheet capacity not treated as operating proof

fact_check_pass.method: After drafting, every material number, period, unit, segment, GAAP/non-GAAP distinction, management explanation and calculation was reread against the official company-released results, SEC 8-K index and recent Form 10-Q; arithmetic was independently recomputed.
